title: Find things faster: Menu for every pad, the slim keys bar, MIDI map
thisBuild: Why holding a pad sometimes gave no menu: a pad that sounds while you hold it (any synth, or a sample set to Sustain or gate) never opens its menu from a hold, because there a hold is playing. So there is now a Menu button by the bank numbers. Tap a pad, tap Menu: it opens that pad's menu for every pad. That is also how a synth gets a Padiano: Menu, then Padiano under this row.
Next to Menu, Sample opens the picked pad's Sample sheet. On a synth pad it says Synth and goes straight to the knobs.

Key, chords and Hold are always on the Play tab now, as one slim row: the Hold switch, and a button that reads what is set (like D minor, chords off). Tap that button to open root, scale, chords, Hold's count and Let go. The ▴ shuts it again. A Padiano still opens it by itself.
The same bar sits over the keys on the Synth tab, in Simple, Full and Synthipad. Chords work there now too.
Synth tab: the pad name at the top is a picker, so you can jump between your synths without leaving the tab (your note). With no synth on the picked pad, the page lists the synths you have.

MIDI map (☰ menu): a small panel floats under the top bar. Tap a pad, then press keys on your keyboard: each key lands on the next pad, to the right and then down. Tap a Padiano key and the keys go up the Padiano from there. Tap a synth knob on the Synth tab and turn a knob or slider on your controller: it turns that knob from then on. Skip passes one, Clear empties the map, Done closes it.
watch: MIDI map with your real keyboard: I could only test it with notes sent in software. Does each key land where the panel says, and do your controller's knobs move the synth knobs smoothly?
Hold a normal sample pad for its menu ten times. I gave a still finger a little more room to roll (it was strict). Send a note if it still misses, with which pad.
The slim keys bar: is one row the right size, and is it clear that the button opens the rest?
limits: A hold on a synth pad still opens no menu, on purpose: use Menu. The app says so once when you try.
MIDI map covers pads, Padiano keys and synth knobs. Buttons like Play and Rec, velocity, and the pad filter are not mappable yet.
Pads map by their place on screen, so a mapped key hits whichever bank is showing. The map is kept on the phone, not in the mess.
